subject: cavescene
name: 山洞
label: 圆拱小山洞
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One rounded rock mound with a big arch-shaped cave opening, two broad rock seams and no black fill.
Pure black OUTLINE ONLY, empty white interiors. Absolutely no solid dark fill, gray wash or hatching. Only the requested forms, no extra shrubs, grass, pebbles or texture. Smooth connected contours. Whole composition fits comfortably inside 10 percent clear margins. Cave opening remains pure white inside, no shaded darkness.
